brief:
Arab and Muslim nations issued strong condemnations of statements by Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir and Defense Minister Yisrael Katz regarding the displacement of Palestinians from Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The countries warned against implementing forced relocation plans for the Palestinian population in the territory.

The statements from the Israeli officials have prompted sharp reactions across the Arab and Muslim world. Nations issued stern denunciations and cautioned that any attempt to forcibly transfer Palestinians from Gaza would represent a serious violation of international law and humanitarian principles governing occupied territories.

title: Arab and Muslim states condemn Israeli plans for Palestinian displacement from Gaza
